decision_scope: Proceed to strict preregistration and evidence collection only. Reconstruction and polygon generation remain blocked.
go_rationale: The interval and corridor are explicit.
At least two political sides and three candidate named polities have documentary pathways, with uncertainty preserved.
Twelve named candidate constraints or exclusions are locatable.
Legal textual access and stable identifiers exist for primary, archaeological and gazetteer follow-up.
A metadata-only held-out design is feasible and automatically testable inside the repository.
held_out_finding: Two candidates are registered from bibliographic or publisher metadata only in fixed priority order. No map body was inspected. A Shepherd candidate was excluded after a search engine exposed a textual label summary.

map_body_audit.audit_note: Only bibliographic/catalog/rights metadata for held-out candidates and non-territorial-map text or archaeological records were accessed. Search-index snippets are disclosed; the tainted Shepherd candidate is excluded.

political_subject_finding: Mercia is directly documented within the interval. Powys and Gwynedd are named candidates supported mainly by retrospective or immediately post-window material and remain unresolved for local control; “Britons” cannot be compiled as one Welsh state.
source_access_finding: Ten non-map textual, charter, monument or scholarly records have stable locators and declared access/rights scopes. Public redistribution is limited to OGL/basic data; citation-only records will not be copied as source bodies.
temporal_finding: The target is precisely bounded as an interval, 780-01-01 through Offa’s death on 796-07-29. Most events are only year-resolved, so no day-precise political snapshot may be claimed.
